name: xerj hook (harness search profiler) - pre-registered verification
status: frozen before any replay run; changes are dated amendments below

stage1_offline_replay.data: local transcript miner events (195,422 tool calls); joined private file stays local
stage1_offline_replay.tuning: none: parameters above are the design's, fixed before the first replay; dev is reported for transparency only
stage1_offline_replay.leakage_guard: history pairs fold only at stream end, replayed in global time order, so a prior never contains the replayed chain's own target
stage1_offline_replay.tree_drift: ranking runs on today's tree; events whose search root no longer exists are excluded and counted

R-1.def: share of code-tree content searches where an active rule (R1-R3) fires; share of streams with no U1 T1 event that get no injection

R-2.def: trigger precision/recall against 300 blind hand-labelled episodes
R-2.note: U1 T1 agreement is reported, not gating (circular)

R-3.def: recall@5 of the eventually-read target on fired events with a scan; arms t0, t0+history, t0+history+t1; baseline target_in_output on the same events

R-3b.def: median calls between the fire and the agent's read of the target, R-3 hits

R-4.def: emitted nudges whose top-1 is the eventual target or a file read in the next 6 calls

R-5.def: hook self-time; silent p99, firing p99; plus end-to-end process spawn on the real binary
R-5.pass: silent p99 <= 25 ms and firing p99 <= 250 ms

R-6.def: tokens per nudge, per stream; non-T1 streams with any injected token

R-7.def: emitted path:line that fails re-anchoring now
R-7.kill: >= 1 is a bug to fix before the pilot

R-8.def: 20 synthetic positive chains fire, 20 negatives stay silent

stage1_offline_replay.go_to_stage2: R-2, R-3, R-5 and R-7 pass

U.pass: median paired turns -20% and cost -15%, T success >= C success - 1, >= 50% of T runs nudge with uptake
U.kill: T cost > C +10%, or T success <= C - 2, or < 25% of T runs ever nudge

E.pass: T nudges in <= 2 of 8 runs and cost <= C +5%

amendments.text: Gate (b) read literally ('>=2 unseen files each covering >=2 terms, top >= 1.3x second') can never pass when exactly one file matches, the most confident case. Implemented as: the top unseen file covers >= 2 distinct chain terms and scores >= 1.3x the next unseen candidate (or has none); every unseen file with >= 2 terms is listed, up to 5.
Stage-2 answer keys are stored only as sha256 above; plain keys stay with the local pilot runner. Stage 2 has not started.

Replay feeds one PostToolUse-shaped call at a time (the miner did not keep batch grouping), so the detector runs per call, not per batch. Output text is the miner's 1 KB preview plus its list of output paths; a cut preview is flagged so its last section never counts as empty.

Chain token specificity lowered from >= 4 to >= 3 characters (stop-words still excluded). The synthetic R-8 check scored 17/20 positives (below the 18/20 pass, above the 15/20 kill) because 3-letter domain words (wal, lod) could not link two searches. Reported both ways; no replay had run.
